Name: Simple Backpack Upgrade (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[left][b]Simple Backpack Upgrade[/b]
[b]More room for your tools, crops, and everything you find along the way.[/b]
Simple Backpack Upgrade adds new backpack upgrades at Pierre’s, with expanded inventory layouts that keep Stardew Valley’s familiar 12-column design.
Backpack progression
[table][tr][th]Upgrade[/th]
[th]Capacity[/th]
[th]Price[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Large Pack — vanilla[/td]
[td]24 slots[/td]
[td]2,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Deluxe Pack — vanilla[/td]
[td]36 slots[/td]
[td]10,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Bigger Pack[/td]
[td]48 slots[/td]
[td]50,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Ultimate Pack[/td]
[td]60 slots[/td]
[td]100,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Optional upgrade[/td]
[td]72 slots[/td]
[td]250,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Optional upgrade[/td]
[td]84 slots[/td]
[td]500,000g[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Upgrades are purchased in order.
Optional extra upgrades
Want even more space? Enable [b]“Enable extra backpack upgrades”[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu to unlock the 72- and 84-slot purchases.
This setting is [b]off by default[/b]. Turning it off later keeps all backpack space you have already purchased, along with your items.
Without GMCM, close the game and set
[code]EnableExtraUpgrades[/code]to
[code]true[/code]in the mod’s
[code]config.json[/code].
Features
[list]
[*]Expanded backpack layouts with 12 slots per row.[/*]
[*]Compact scrolling and an expand button in supported space-constrained menus.[/*]
[*]Larger inventory and chest layouts when sufficient screen space is available.[/*]
[*]Controller navigation and toolbar cycling through the additional rows.[/*]
[*]Compatibility adjustments for UI Info Suite 2 2.3.7 and UI Info Suite 2 Alternative 2.9.0.[/*]
[*]Support for all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[*]Configurable upgrade prices.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]SimpleBackpackUpgrade[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Visit Pierre’s to purchase your next backpack upgrade.[/*]
[/list]When updating, replace the mod files and keep your
[code]config.json[/code].
If updating from the old
[code]BiggerBackpack[/code]folder, rename it to
[code]SimpleBackpackUpgrade[/code]first. Keep only one copy installed.
[/left]
